config.notes: 0.0.10 release-prep campaign COMPLETE. All 5 pipeline workflows executed in order: code_review (REV-001 and REV-002 resolved inline; REV-003 deferred; REV-005 confirmed clean), pre_release (version bumped to 0.0.10 across package metadata + public version surface; wheel built; 2822/2822 conformance; 8000 pass pytest with 1 pre-existing failure documented), docs_audit (4 notebooks bumped; all internal links verified; release notes generated with Known Limitations), benchmarks (0 timing regressions; suite total 1.031x baseline; median faster than baseline), scribe (commit message draft at .temp/draft_commit.txt). issues.evidence: Cross-library define references (A."X") in scalar context still produce SELECT * FROM "A.X" causing Binder Error: Subquery returns 2 columns. Initial fix (commit 3ba87aa0) regressed DQM conformance on CMS0334 (9.6%) and CMS190 (7.2%) because it intercepted CTE creation paths as well as references; reverted in 06544fbf.
issues.root_cause: The fix needs to distinguish CTE creation/passthrough from CTE reference in scalar context; the broader code path lacks the usage-context info needed to make that distinction.
issues.resolution: Documented as Known Limitation in 0.0.10 release notes. Tracked as 0.0.11 follow-up.

issues.evidence: FHIRPath is() on empty collections returns [false] for non-FHIR-primitive types instead of propagating the empty collection. Python-side fix (commit 683d67da) created C++/Python parity mismatch because the native extension still returns [false]; reverted in 8f71e9dd.
issues.root_cause: The Python is_fn and the C++ fn_isType need to be updated in lockstep to preserve the parity invariant test_type_parity.py enforces.
issues.resolution: Documented as Known Limitation in 0.0.10 release notes. Tracked as 0.0.11 follow-up (requires C++ extension update).
issues.verified_in: test_type_parity.py passes after revert; TestIsLowercaseTypes::test_empty_collection_returns_empty remains the documented pre-existing failure.
